notes: Volumetric (static, Quantachrome NOVA 3200e) H2 uptake at -196 C (77 K), 0.01-1 bar, on KOH/ZnCl2-activated cyanobacteria-derived carbons and their HNO3/NH3.H2O/H3PO4-modified (N- or P-doped) variants; uptakes in mg/g in Table 5 (p. 8) and Figs. 7-8. BET areas (N2 at -196 C) in Tables 2-5. The text layer drops minus signs ("196  C"); the minus in -196 C was confirmed on page images main-01, main-03 and main-07. Carbon content of the activated carbons is not reported (only 43.28 wt% C for raw cyanobacteria, Table 1); they are KOH/ZnCl2-activated, HCl-washed activated carbons and were taken as carbon sorbents. No retraction notice, no review/thesis form, and no statement that the uptake values were published before. Table 5 'Ref.' rows are quoted literature values, not this paper's measurements.
